message.content: I'm ending my turn without building or unmortgaging. I'm keeping my $317 because I'm sitting on Electric Company, right before your orange set (4 houses on each), so I'll need cash if I land there. I also skipped upgrading St. Charles and States to hotels. That would send 8 houses back to the bank, which only has 2 left, and you could use them to build up your greens and Park Place/Boardwalk.
message.reasoning:
With $317 cash, I'm weighing whether to build hotels on St. Charles and States, since that would return houses to the bank and potentially let p4 build up Park Place/Boardwalk further—I need to think about whether that helps or hurts my position.

Actually, p4's cash is limited and keeping houses locked up denies them that option, so I'd rather preserve my cash and not build hotels right now. I'm more worried about p4's orange properties at 16, 18, 19 which could hit me for $950-1000 in rent if they get hotels, so I need to stay liquid for that threat—I'll just end my turn without building.
